title: Minimum Number of String Groups Through Transformations
summary: Transform a string by independently cyclically rotating its even-index and odd-index character subsequences, then interleaving them back into their original parity positions. Partition words into the fewest groups where every pair is related by such a transformation. Return the group count; characters cannot switch index parity.
officialConstraints: 1..100000 lowercase words; individual and total length at most500000; no empty words.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
